remarks: MUST SEE!!! SPACIOUS & beautifully appointed traditional Colonial; completely renovated, move-in ready & mere steps from the picturesque Niagara River and the attractions of Canalside and Downtown Buffalo. This open-concept, captivating home has an abundance of natural light with modern & elegant updates throughout and peacefully rests on a quiet street for refreshing morning strolls. Take your first steps through the front door into the generous living room featuring recessed lighting, crown molding, and original Oak hardwood floors flowing throughout opening into the formal dining room with a charming electric fireplace with brick surround, perfect for cozying up next to with a warm cup of coffee on brisk fall mornings. The kitchen has been attractively remodeled w/hardwood soft-close cabinetry, distinctive Quartz counters, LVP flooring, and honeycomb style backsplash while the full bathroom downstairs has tile flooring, a glass-enclosed tile surround shower with custom niche accent and rain shower head. Enjoy the three generous bedrooms and 2nd full bath upstairs, also with tile flooring and low-step entry, tile surround shower. Full walk-up attic with a finished room could be a potential 4th bedroom and makes for ample storage & ease of living. Impeccably kept w/luxurious finishes, this desirable home has remarkable updates including arch. shingle roof, gutters, windows, wood privacy fence, paint & landscaping all in 2026, Rheem HWT 2018, as well as updates to the electrical with low taxes & close to all conveniences! Showings start 9/30/2026. Open House Saturday, October 10th from 11:00 am-1:00 pm.
